cues.text: Everyone on your team has their own skills, in their own versions. None of them match.
Meet Dalo. There's nothing new to learn. Just ask your agent.
Dalo finds them, checks them, and shows you exactly what changed.
Your team picks the skills once, in Git. Everyone gets the same set, in Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor.
Underneath the conversation sits a deterministic core.
New skills wait for your approval.
And Dalo only touches what it owns.
Manage your agent's setup. Just ask.
